setup.tryIt: After linking finishes, send a WhatsApp DM to the connected account.
setup.summary: WhatsApp is connected by scanning a QR code from the account that should run the bot.
steps: Choose Connect WhatsApp to show a QR code in the browser.
In WhatsApp on your phone, open Linked devices and scan the code.
After linking, enable WhatsApp and send a direct test message.

custom.scanDescription: In WhatsApp, open Linked devices, choose Link a device, then scan this code.
custom.stopped: The WhatsApp connection attempt stopped. Start again to get a new code.
